$schema.description: Where this schema is published; editors use it, Ominous ignores it.

calendars.description: Calendars that alert, by name or id (see `omacal calendars`). Empty = all of them.

onlyWithLink.description: true = alert only for meetings with an https join link.

leadSeconds.description: Seconds before the start when the card appears (0-3600).

tenseSeconds.description: Seconds before the start when the card turns tense (0-3600); 0 = never.

dim.description: Opacity of the veil behind the card, 0-1; null = the theme's own.

mode.description: Mode until you switch on the card (M): professional or playful.

themes.description: Theme of each mode (see `omarchy-shell ominous themes`).
